# ProdOS CoS Full Sweep & "Right Now" Execution Plan (Experiment Mode)

## Context & Current State
- **Date & Time:** Thursday, 26 November 2026, 10:42 AM GMT (work window: 09:00–17:00)[span_0](start_span)[span_0](end_span).
- **Role & Setting:** Staff Platform Architect working 9–5 on computer/Jira work alongside personal/family life, managing lifelong adult ADHD executive dysfunction (time blindness, initiation paralysis, competing DMN/TPN / switching inertia, open-ended tickets, and attention residue)[span_1](start_span)[span_1](end_span)[span_2](start_span)[span_2](end_span)[span_3](start_span)[span_3](end_span)[span_4](start_span)[span_4](end_span)[span_5](start_span)[span_5](end_span)[span_6](start_span)[span_6](end_span).
- **Vault & Tooling:** LLMeon / ProdOS vault with access to vault notes, Todoist, Jira, calendar/Fantastical MCP, and email/Spark MCP (respect `AGENTS.md` and `own_words: true` / protected directories—do NOT do system tinkering or redesign protocols during this sweep)[span_7](start_span)[span_7](end_span)[span_8](start_span)[span_8](end_span)[span_9](start_span)[span_9](end_span).

## Why We Are Running This Sweep (The Experiment)
- **Observed Failure Mode:** Only some things are in Todoist; daily routine reminders and meetings sit on the calendar; Todoist gets ignored; I end up redeciding what to do all the time and struggle to visualise completion or switch tickets once engaged[span_10](start_span)[span_10](end_span)[span_11](start_span)[span_11](end_span).
- **Core Hypothesis:** A "Single Source of Truth" is not one giant flat Todoist list—it is a **momentary clarity loop** where the CoS aggregates my actual landscape (calendar/meetings/routines, active Jira work, Todoist runway, and relevant email/MCP signals) and hands me **one clear "right now" block** plus a small set of bounded blocks for the rest of today, with a concrete **"done means"**, a **<2-minute physical starter action**, and a **clean exit / state-capture note** so I don't have to redecide or carry open-ended mental residue[span_12](start_span)[span_12](end_span)[span_13](start_span)[span_13](end_span)[span_14](start_span)[span_14](end_span)[span_15](start_span)[span_15](end_span)[span_16](start_span)[span_16](end_span).
- **Experiment Constraint:** **No system tinkering, schema edits, or protocol rewriting.** Execute the sweep, surface what actually matters right now, and give me an actionable plan for the rest of today.

---

## Instructions for Claude (Run the Full Sweep)
1. **Read & Aggregate Across Sources (Read-Only Sweep First):**
   - Check my calendar(s) for today (Thursday, 26 Nov 2026) from now (10:42) through 17:00 (and any relevant evening/family/routine context so I don't miss hard constraints or pick-ups/routines)[span_17](start_span)[span_17](end_span).
   - Check active/in-progress/blocked Jira tickets relevant to my work today[span_18](start_span)[span_18](end_span).
   - Check Todoist (inbox/runway/routines/active items) and relevant vault notes/projects if needed for context—without modifying vault notes or inventing fake due dates on soft tasks[span_19](start_span)[span_19](end_span)[span_20](start_span)[span_20](end_span).
   - Check recent/unread emails via Spark MCP for anything actionable or blocking today[span_21](start_span)[span_21](end_span).

2. **Synthesise Into a "Right Now" Single Source of Truth (Keep It Crisp, Low-Friction & Bounded):**
   - **1. Right Now (Next Action):** Name the **single** thing I should do immediately after reading this—written as a concrete physical verb (<2 min starter) with a clear **30–60m box** and a explicit **"Done means"** (what finished looks like for this slice so it isn't open-ended)[span_22](start_span)[span_22](end_span)[span_23](start_span)[span_23](end_span)[span_24](start_span)[span_24](end_span)[span_25](start_span)[span_25](end_span).
   - **2. Rest of Today's Proposed Blocks (10:42–17:00):** Propose a realistic, bounded sequence around existing calendar meetings/routines, leaving **~25% buffer** and capping active focus blocks so I am not redeciding every hour[span_26](start_span)[span_26](end_span)[span_27](start_span)[span_27](end_span)[span_28](start_span)[span_28](end_span)[span_29](start_span)[span_29](end_span). Flag any unscheduled/routine items I am *deliberately not* doing today so I can ignore Todoist guilt-free[span_30](start_span)[span_30](end_span)[span_31](start_span)[span_31](end_span)[span_32](start_span)[span_32](end_span).
   - **3. Waiting-For / Comms / Open Loops:** Briefly list any external blockers or email/Jira items needing a quick triage pass or waiting state—without dumping them onto my immediate "do now" list[span_33](start_span)[span_33](end_span)[span_34](start_span)[span_34](end_span).
   - **4. Switching & Exit Cue:** Include a 1-line **On-Stop / Switch Rule** (what to jot down before switching to the next block or meeting) to reduce attention residue and help me disengage cleanly[span_35](start_span)[span_35](end_span)[span_36](start_span)[span_36](end_span).

3. **Ask at Most 1–2 Quick Confirmation Questions** only if needed to lock in today's blocks (e.g., accepting/tweaking the proposed blocks), then wait for my go-ahead before making any external task/calendar mutations.
